business.name: Blue Fin Asian Fusion Hibachi & Sushi Bar

evidence.observedFact: The active website publishes current Mentor hours, location, phone and email and offers online ordering.
Blue Fin actively markets private parties for birthdays, office functions, holiday parties, corporate events and wedding festivities and provides a party-booking path.
The restaurant also markets catering packages for birthdays, weddings, corporate events and other occasions alongside its dine-in and online-ordering business.

gaps.recommendedFix: Demonstrate a post-party and post-catering guest retention workflow using opt-in rewards, return-visit offers and trackable referrals to turn event audiences into repeat restaurant customers.
Test a trackable referral offer for event hosts and consenting guests; this is a sales hypothesis based on the public event/catering model, not proof that the business currently lacks referrals.

notes: The event and catering model creates a concrete audience for retention and referral workflows. The referral category is explicitly an opportunity hypothesis; no claim is made that existing referrals are deficient. No monetary loss is inferred.
